activity.notes: Choe Museon secured gunpowder production and prompted the establishment of the Hwathong Dogam in 1377; in 1380 he helped employ gunpowder weapons against the Wokou fleet at Jinpo. ATLAS uses 1377–1380 as the representative state military-technology activity interval.

sources.title: 최무선
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture describes Choe Museon's establishment of gunpowder and firearms production and his 1380 participation in defeating the Wokou fleet at Jinpo.

sources.title: 화통도감
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture states that Hwathong Dogam was established in 1377 on Choe Museon's proposal.
